title: ServerConnectionSettingsContract
description: Local storage and connection verification contract for the Configurable Server Connection Settings feature.

custom_base_url.description: Normalized base URL override (e.g. 'http://192.168.1.50:8080/api/v1') or null when using default

connectionProbe.description: HTTP probe used by the 'Test Connection' action in the Settings modal

endpoint.description: Appended to the normalized base URL (e.g. GET http://192.168.1.50:8080/api/v1/auth/demo-accounts)
